text_block_list.text:
Spe? You haven't changed your clothes
yet. Did the zipper get stuck?
Should I fix
it?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! Nothing's wrong with it! I'm just
feeling kinda... starstruck, I
guess.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's hard to explain, but everything I saw
from up onstage—it was
amazing.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'd like to see it with you again
someday.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ah! Me too! Let's do it again, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! Quit slacking off, you
two! We gotta get ready to
m-o-v-e move!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You don't want the after-party to start
without us, do you?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Talk about a luxurious feast! This is
way more than I expected!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Dunno if you've noticed, Spe, but this kind of party's called an after-party because with this amount of food, your tummy will be hanging low long after the party!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Honestly... I'm just astonished by what
comes out of your mouth
sometimes.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Is that a compliment from the one
and only, the most venerable
McQueen? I
am most honorably honored. ☆
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: That wasn't a compliment in the slightest!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Haha! Guess I'm in charge of taking all
McQueen's extra sweets to
help her not
overeat.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I-I don't need any such kind of help! I'll
show you, this is self-restraint
befitting the
Mejiro name.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Um... Maybe we should start getting food.
Yeah, Spe?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huh? Scarlet? You not gettin' anythin'?
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Mmph... I'll get some later... I just need
some time...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Hey, c'mon... Sheesh, the so-called honor
student's really wiped
herself out, huh?
...Wait here, I'll go grab us somethin'!
text_block_list.name: Водка
